---
title: Project Expenses
description: The proposed budget, the total spent to date, and the cost of the final design of the Safe Dip prototype.
---

This page compares three budgets: the budget proposed in the Senior Design Proposal, the total spent on the prototype to date, and the cost of the parts in the final design. Prices are from the commercial listings the parts were bought from and exclude taxes and shipping.
